:::{#def-closed-form-expression}
#### Closed-form expression (formula)

A **closed-form expression** (or **formula**)
[@wikipedia_closed_form_expression]
is an [expression](#def-expression) built from a fixed, finite set of accepted operations and functions,
such as constants, variables, arithmetic, powers, roots, $\exp$, $\log$ and the trigonometric functions.
The accepted set is a convention, and a source states it when it matters.

:::
